1| # archive uploads
2| 
3| Rolled segments push to the archive store in fixed-size parts with
4| a checkpoint after every acknowledged part. Interrupted pushes
5| resume from the checkpoint rather than restarting the object, which
6| is why the sizing is uniform per object and owned by code.
7| 
8| Throughput planning multiplies the part size by the acknowledged
9| parts-per-minute rate from the uplink dashboard; both factors sit in
10| the transfer-budget sheet, and the sheet cites this page next to the
11| throughput row so reviewers can check the arithmetic against the
12| mechanics instead of taking the row on faith.
13| 
14| ## Overnight window
15| 
16| Pushes run in the overnight window the export schedule defines.
17| Daytime pushes are possible in an emergency but contend with the
18| exports for uplink, so the runbook requires a storage sign-off
19| before anyone starts one.
